verdict.rationale: Appwrite's storage product page says its preview endpoint can resize, crop, convert format, set quality, add borders, and rotate images from a single upload. That covers the core of serving transformed images without a self-run pipeline, and the storage docs back it up by describing file APIs 'with many added utilities.' missing for 10: in-depth API documentation of the preview endpoint (parameters, limits, caching/CDN delivery), independent or hands-on corroboration.
